# Ayur Veda Global — Full Pharmacopeia & Knowledge Base

## 1. Brand Identity & Heritage
Ayur Veda Global is a high-performance Ayurvedic wellness institution rooted in classical compendia (Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita, Ashtanga Hridaya) and validated through contemporary NABL analytical protocols. We manufacture 100% vegetarian, non-GMO herbal formulations free of artificial stimulants, animal gelatins, parabens, or synthetic numbness chemicals.

All orders are processed with strict patron privacy:
- Unmarked plain kraft exterior cartons.
- Zero sensitive words on courier transport labels.
- Discrete delivery across 19,000+ Indian PIN codes via BlueDart, Delhivery, and DTDC.
- Customer support and free doctor consultations accessible via WhatsApp: +91-9123485451.

## 2. Formulation Catalog & Clinical Profiles

### BODY Essential Nutrition (60 Capsules)
- SKU: AVG-BEN-60
- Format: Vegetarian HPMC Capsules (60 count)
- Price: ₹899 INR (MRP: ₹1,499 INR)
- Primary Indication: Chronic fatigue, physical stamina depletion, tissue revitalization (Dhatu Poshan), and sustained muscle vitality.
- Key Botanicals: Standardized Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera), Shuddha Shilajit (>75% Fulvic Acid), Safed Musli (Chlorophytum borivilianum), Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris), Kaunch Beej (Mucuna pruriens), and Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica).
- Dosage & Administration: 1-2 capsules twice daily after meals with lukewarm milk or water, or as directed by an Ayurvedic physician.
- Safety & Contraindications: Safe for long-term daily consumption. Free from steroids, heavy metals, and synthetic stimulants.

### STAYMAX+ Delay Spray (30 ml)
- SKU: AVG-SMX-30
- Format: Precision metered topical spray (30 ml bottle, 100+ sprays)
- Price: ₹899 INR (MRP: ₹1,499 INR)
- Primary Indication: Men's endurance support, prolonging intimate duration, enhancing confidence without numbness or loss of sensation.
- Active Composition: Calibrated mild desensitizing agent balanced with soothing Aloe Vera extract, Ashwagandha extract, and pure essential oils.
- Mode of Application: Spray 2-3 pumps onto the intended area 10-15 minutes prior to intimate activity. Absorbs cleanly without stickiness or residue. Wash off post-activity if oral contact is planned.
- Safety & Age Restriction: For adult external use only (18+). Dermatologically evaluated. Do not spray on broken skin or abrasions.
